dataset.preprocessing: tokenize each raw row with the pinned tokenizer and add_special_tokens=false; retain the first 64 tokens; prompt is tokens [0,32), completion is tokens [32,64)
dataset.selection: for each fixed source-row offset, choose the first non-empty row at or after the offset with at least sequence_length tokens; no random sampling
dataset.truncation: first-64-token truncation; rows shorter than 64 tokens are skipped

evaluation.hard_route: deterministic argmax over [p4,p8], index 0 -> 4-bit and index 1 -> 8-bit
evaluation.quality_metric: mean absolute logit error against the full-precision teacher on the validation examples
